steps.code:
def get_release_month_year(title, artists_str):
    # Use the first artist for search
    first_artist = artists_str.split(',')[0].strip()
    query = f"{title} {first_artist}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_limit=5)
    if not results:
        return None
    # Find exact title match
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            rd = song['release_date']
            # rd format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"
            parts = rd.split('-')
            return f"{parts[1]}/{parts[0]}"
    # fallback to first result
    rd = results[0]['release_date']
    parts = rd.split('-')
    return f"{parts[1]}/{parts[0]}"

for title, artists in todo_songs:
    print(title, artists, '->', get_release_month_year(title, artists))
